snapshot.title: Drone Operator Apprehended — Evidence Handover

transcript.speaker: CCSO Liaison
transcript.text: This is the Harwick Police CCSO Liaison. We have located the operator in the public park west of Hangar 1. The drone has landed 200 meters from the fairgrounds and was secured. We are handovering the aircraft, the controller (model: DJI M350 RC), and the SD card with the flight log to your security team. The operator is in custody. Please log the evidence in your incident folder under ERP-1001.

snapshot.instructorNote: Confirm the ASO has received the physical evidence and initiated the log entry in the incident folder. Verify the SHA-256 manifest is in place for forensic integrity.
